What the shop does

Haircuts and fades

Scissor cuts, fades, buzz cuts, long hair and shape ups. Customers write that they get exactly the cut they described, plus good advice on styles.

Beards and shaves

Beard trim and conditioning, straight razor shave and hot towel shave.

Extras

Eyebrows, hair wash and conditioning, scalp treatment, facial treatment and hair colouring.

Appointments and kids

Appointments are recommended, by phone or online, and customers say they start on time. Kids are welcome too.

Inside the shop

Photos from the shop’s Google listing.

Why customers come back

What customers notice on Google.

Beard care

Beard care comes up again and again, from the trim to the hot towel. One customer writes that his mustache never looked better.

Kind and cheerful

Kind staff is what reviews mention most. Customers are offered coffee, tea or sweets, and good conversation.

A beautiful, clean space

Plants on black grids, copper and rope lights, and a shop that customers call clean and tidy.

On the corner of Thessalonikis street

The shop sits on a corner at Thessalonikis 58, with parking right across the road. Some customers came along from before the shop even opened, and the Google reviews go back five years. Many bring their sons with them.
